knowledge_points.content: ASe-5 is a selenium-containing non-fused electron acceptor (nfEA) designed with a 1,1-dicyanomethylene-3-indanone (IC-2Cl) terminal group to achieve redshifted absorption and reduced energy loss.
knowledge_points.evidence: we designed and synthesized a Se-containing nfEAs with 1,1-dicyanomethylene-3-indanone (IC-2Cl) as the terminal group, named ASe-5... The results suggest that the incorporation of Se atoms leads to a slight increase in the cost when compared to its thiophene analog A4T-16.

knowledge_points.content: The PBQx-TF:ASe-5-based organic photovoltaic device achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 14.7%, with an open-circuit voltage (VOC) of 0.836 V, a short-circuit current (JSC) of 23.6 mA/cm², and a fill factor (FF) of 0.744.
knowledge_points.evidence: the PBQx-TF:ASe-5-based cell exhibits the highest PCE for selenium-containing nfEAs, with a PCE of 14.7% (VOC = 0.836 V; JSC = 23.6 mA cm−2; FF = 0.744).

knowledge_points.content: Selenium-containing non-fused acceptors like ASe-5 exhibit redshifted absorption spectra (optical bandgap of 1.37 eV) and higher carrier mobilities compared to their thiophene-based analogs.
knowledge_points.evidence: Selenium-containing (Se-containing) nfEAs show redshifted absorption spectra, higher carrier mobilities, and lower nonradiative energy loss compared with their thiophene analogs... the absorption edge of ASe-5 extends to ≈908 nm, indicating an optical bandgap (Eg opt) of 1.37 eV.

knowledge_points.content: The PBQx-TF:ASe-5 blend shows suppressed trap-assisted recombination compared to PBDB-TF:ASe-5, as evidenced by a lower slope (S') of 1.11 versus 1.19 in the VOC vs. light intensity relationship.
knowledge_points.evidence: The S' value of the PBDB-TF:ASe-5-based device is 1.19, which is higher than that of the PBQx-TF:ASe-5-based device (1.11), implying that trap-assisted recombination is effectively suppressed in the latter.

knowledge_points.content: In situ UV-vis absorption measurements reveal that the aggregation process of ASe-5 takes longer in the PBQx-TF blend (1.34 s) than in the PBDB-TF blend (1.02 s) due to the earlier formation of a polymer network by PBQx-TF.
knowledge_points.evidence: The duration of the redshift process of the ASe-5 absorption peak in the PBQx-TF:ASe-5 blend is 1.34 s, which is longer than that of the PBDB-TF:ASe-5 blend (1.02 s)... PBQx-TF may form polymer networks earlier in high-temperature toluene solution due to stronger preaggregation.

knowledge_points.content: Transient absorption (TA) spectroscopy indicates that PBQx-TF:ASe-5 films possess faster hole transfer and a longer charge carrier lifetime (1071 ps) compared to PBDB-TF:ASe-5 (565 ps).
knowledge_points.evidence: PBQx-TF:ASe-5-based film exhibits a longer lifetime of 1071 ps compared with that of PBDB-TF:ASe-5-based films (565 ps), suggesting a more suppressed charge recombination... confirming its faster hole transfer process.

knowledge_points.content: Electrostatic potential (ESP) calculations show that PBQx-TF has an averaged ESP of 0.029 kcal/mol, which is higher than that of PBDB-TF (-0.315 kcal/mol), resulting in decreased intermolecular electrostatic attraction with ASe-5 (4.54 kcal/mol).
knowledge_points.evidence: The averaged ESP of PBDB-TF, PBQx-TF, and ASe-5 are -0.315, 0.029, and 4.54 kcal mol−1 respectively. We can speculate that the intermolecular electrostatic attraction between PBQx-TF and ASe-5 is decreased when compared with that in the PBDB-TF:ASe-5 combination.

knowledge_points.content: The selenium-containing acceptor ASe-5 demonstrates good thermal stability with a 5% weight loss temperature (Td) of 363 °C.
knowledge_points.evidence: Thermogravimetric analysis was applied to evaluate the thermal stability of the ASe-5... the result shows that the thermal degradation temperature at 5% weight loss is 363 °C.

knowledge_points.content: PBQx-TF:ASe-5-based devices processed with the green solvent o-xylene achieved a PCE of 12.2%, with a VOC of 0.830 V and a JSC of 20.3 mA/cm².
knowledge_points.evidence: The PBQx-TF:ASe-5-based cells using o-xylene achieve a moderate PCE of 12.2% with a VOC of 0.830 V, JSC of 20.3 mA cm−2, and a FF of 0.724.

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS analysis shows that both PBDB-TF:ASe-5 and PBQx-TF:ASe-5 blends prefer a face-on orientation, with the PBQx-TF-based blend showing a slightly smaller π-π stacking distance of 3.69 Å.
knowledge_points.evidence: The GIWAXS results reveal that both blends have an obvious (010) peak in the out-of-plane (OOP) direction, indicating that the face-on molecular orientations are predominant... PBQx-TF:ASe-5-based blend film has a slightly smaller π-π stacking distance of 3.69 Å.

knowledge_points.content: The material-only cost (MOC) of the non-fused acceptor ASe-5 is estimated at 103.1 $ per gram, which is significantly lower than the cost of the fused-ring acceptor Y6 (146.9 $ per gram).
knowledge_points.evidence: The MOCs of Y6, A4T-16, and ASe-5 are estimated to be 146.9, 89.3, and 103.1 $ g−1, respectively... the cost of nfEAs (A4T-16 and ASe-5) remains significantly lower than that of fEAs (Y6).
